description: The OBJ a wagon model declaration names, read as the game reads it (pack.ModelCheck.check after WagonModelDecl.parse; ObjLoader.loadModel): a path Minecraft refuses, a missing file, a face index out of bounds, a number Java refuses, no faces. input: namespace (the declaring file's, for unqualified paths), declaration (the wagon model's JSON), files (ns:path -> text), present (locations that are there, contents unread: textures); any other key with a colon is a file too (what input_file reads of the example pack). A location is valid as Minecraft takes it: [a-z0-9_.-]+:[a-z0-9/._-]+. expected: the problems in the check's order, each {severity: error | warning, finding}; the engine gives only the finding's text yet (code, subject, index null, params {}).

cases.note: the OBJ isn't there: nothing more is checked

files.t:car/car.obj:
mtllib car.mtl
v 0 0 0
v 1 0 0
v 1 1 0
v 0 1 0
vt 0 0
o BODY
usemtl body
f 1/1 2/1 3/1 4/1
